descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S28 A 1,500-character Hospital pre-round: every lab, medication and study is kept, and plan items after character 1,200 still become tasks

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Save Note turns the input into the prototype's summary shape: first a Background (a one-liner with age, sex, reason for admission and significant PMH woven in, then active-issue bullets), then vitals … (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 1; TFA-92588 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U8 Pre-round tasks (the plan items) appear in the task list. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 10; TFA-92588 How it works 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given The make-session Hospital patient (Community-acquired pneumonia), nothing else on file

When Type the long text below into the pre-round box, Save Note, look at the Pre-Round panels, then the Encounter tab's Tasks

Then Labs hold all 12 labs, Medications all 7 drugs with their doses, Diagnostic Testing all 3 studies; no panel shows its empty state except Vitals; the two plan items at the end (ask ID about removing the PICC line, a repeat echocardiogram for Friday) are tasks

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): scripts/oracle.mjs: lab names and decimal values, drug names with doses, study words, and the two plan items on the Tasks list. Code read predicts cp2 Fails: usePreRoundProcess.ts sends input.trim().substring(0, 1200) to extractTasks, and the plan starts at character 1404. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S28 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
